metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Warfare
metas.description: A platoon of Navy SEALs embark on a dangerous mission in Ramadi, Iraq, with the chaos and brotherhood of war retold through their memories of the event.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Sisu: Road to Revenge
metas.description: A man returns to dismantle his family's house, where they were murdered in war, to rebuild it elsewhere. When the killer, a Red Army commander, tracks him down, a brutal cross-country pursuit begins.
